title: Pharmacokinetic and Tolerance Study of Meloxicam Eye Drops in Healthy Volunteers
brief_summary: The pharmacokinetics, safety, and tolerability of meloxicam eye drops in Chinese healthy volunteers were evaluated to provide a basis for the formulation of a phase II clinical trial dosing regimen for this product. Including pre-tests and formal trials, formal trials include single-dose pharmacokinetics tests and multiple-dose tolerance tests (4 times a day for 3 consecutive days).
